title: MicroRNA Gatekeepers: Integrating Growth, Development, and Stress Adaptation in Cotton.
authors: Li, Jiarui; Wang, Xuan; Qin, Jiawang; Wu, Yifan; Wei, Mengyao; Li, Chaofan; Jia, Yanfeng
one_liner_zh: 该文综述棉花中miRNA调控生长发育与胁迫适应，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合机制或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: As the primary cash crop for natural fiber, cotton develops under sophisticated endogenous genetic programs, with biotic and abiotic stresses continuously driving its adaptive evolution. MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are post-transcriptional regulators that modulate gene expression via target mRNA cleavage, translational repression, and mediation of DNA methylation. miRNAs target transcription factors and hormone signaling pathways to regulate cotton plant architecture and fiber development. In addition, miRNAs mitigate biotic and abiotic stresses through ROS, lignin, and hormone pathways, as well as by forming competing endogenous RNA (ceRNA) modules with long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs). This review establishes an miRNA-centered regulatory framework that coordinates cotton growth, development, and stress resistance. A series of technologies, including multi-omics combined with machine learning, gene overexpression, STTM, MIM, MIGS, CRISPR editing, foliar dsRNA spraying, and bionanocarriers, are proposed to facilitate the breeding of cotton varieties with high yield, superior fiber quality, and broad-spectrum stress tolerance.
abstract_zh: 棉花作为天然纤维的主要经济作物，其发育受复杂的內源遗传程序调控，生物和非生物胁迫持续驱动其适应性进化。微小RNA（miRNAs）是转录后调控因子，通过靶标mRNA切割、翻译抑制及介导DNA甲基化来调节基因表达。miRNAs靶向转录因子和激素信号通路，调控棉花植株结构和纤维发育。此外，miRNAs通过活性氧（ROS）、木质素和激素途径，以及与长链非编码RNA（lncRNAs）形成竞争性内源RNA（ceRNA）模块，缓解生物和非生物胁迫。本综述构建了一个以miRNA为中心的调控框架，协调棉花生长、发育和抗逆性。提出了一系列技术，包括多组学结合机器学习、基因过表达、STTM、MIM、MIGS、CRISPR编辑、叶面dsRNA喷洒及生物纳米载体，以促进高产、优质纤维和广谱抗逆棉花品种的培育。
